compared: per open/set/apply step: the whole session afterwards; per union step: the whole catalog union

excluded.render: OPEN (port decision): `renderToolSearch` on a native-provider session (openai-oauth, anthropic-oauth: no toolExposureMode) selects the tools and answers `{selected, nativeToolSearch, loaded, alreadyActive, missing, blocked}`; the core's `load_tool` (orch/bridge.rs over SessionCatalog) only describes, as Node's bridge mode does, and has no native branch
excluded.select: OPEN (port decision): `selectDeferredTools` without `exact` is what Node's native `load_tool` runs; the core selects only for a skill's dependencies (HeaderSkillArm, `exact: true`), so no core entry point runs this selection

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder
